cells.gaps: No share of returns filed online is held; the mandate found covers non-resident suppliers of digital services, and the 2017 mandate for all firms is older than three years.
cells.note: Decree 2.25.862 makes electronic VAT filing and payment mandatory for non-resident suppliers of digital services, and the DGI platform for it opened in May 2026. Online filing is mandatory for some taxpayers, which is the top rung.
